summary:
quality lens over frontend-shell-login (22 product path(s), b0b62bc..528688a, Codex via the autoreview skill at --max-priority P2): 1 blocking, 2 non-blocking. The main shell and login flow are reachable, but the expired-session logout path does not perform the required login fallback, and two acceptance-critical login details diverge from the normative contract.
VERDICT t8-c1: implemented — frontend/app/(app)/layout.tsx:8 mounts the guarded AppShell on the authenticated route group
VERDICT t8-c2: partial — frontend/src/components/shell/app-shell.tsx:40 redirects and clears session state only after successful logout
VERDICT t8-c3: partial — frontend/src/features/auth/login-form.tsx:12 differs from the required invalid-code copy, and frontend/app/globals.css:175 uses Mint on a light surface
VERDICT t8-c4: implemented — frontend/src/components/shell/app-shell.tsx:11 defines exactly the five required navigation entries with only Dashboard active
No compatibility wrappers, aliases, deprecated branches, or other blocking leftovers are present in the supplied diff.

blocking_findings.summary: [P1] Fall back to login when logout remains unauthorized (frontend/src/components/shell/app-shell.tsx:40): Navigation and session-cache clearing occur only in `onSuccess`.

t8-c2: email+OTP login works end-to-end under the spec's local runtime contract: a successful verification lands in the shell, logout returns to /login, and an access-token 401 retries once through POST /api/auth/refresh before falling back to /login. The client (frontend/src/lib/api.ts) uses credentials:'include' against the auth allow-list (GET /api/auth/csrf bootstrap, POST otp/request, POST otp/verify, GET me, POST refresh, POST logout) and sends x-csrf-token re-read from the current 3f_csrf cookie immediately before EVERY mutating request (never cached); server state is TanStack Query (me as a query the route guard reads, otp/logout as mutations that prime/invalidate it)

t8-c3: the login screen implements the spec's normative Login screen contract (docs/specs/app-platform-base.md §Login screen contract): a split screen from _ds tokens (left Deep Forest #0C3529 brand panel with the '3F Financial MIS' wordmark + one value line, Mint #6AF1B0 as a thin on-dark accent only; right a white card on the Off-White canvas; brand panel stacks above the card at 390x844), the two-step flow (email type=email autocomplete=email + Emerald #1C6B49 'Send code' 44px at radius-md; then a 6-digit field inputmode=numeric autocomplete=one-time-code client-validated /^\d{6}$/ with Emerald 'Verify', a 'Use a different email' back link and 'Resend code'), the load-bearing uniform copy ('If that email has access, a code is on its way.' / 'That code didn't match - check it or resend.'), and the accessibility (real <label>s, aria-live=polite acks/errors, focus to the code field after Send and to the first error on failure, :active feedback, ease-out <=200ms entry transitions, prefers-reduced-motion respected), verified by the user-facing functional check at 1440x900 and 390x844

non_blocking_findings.summary: [P2] Use the contract's exact invalid-code message (frontend/src/features/auth/login-form.tsx:12): The required load-bearing copy is `That code didn't match - check it or resend.`, but this constant substitutes an em dash.

[P2] Do not use the Mint focus ring on the white login card (frontend/app/globals.css:175): This shared rule applies `--kl-mint` to `.text-action:focus-visible`, although those controls render on the white login card.
